topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: People bend the truth, twist it until it don't resemble nothin' from the get-go. Found out my buddy's been playin’ dress-up at the office, stringin’ folks along with a tall tale about his gig. Tales like his, they unravel, leave folks standin' in the cold, rain, and mud wonderin' what the hell happened. But I seen it all before, the slick smiles, the stories that shine like a new dime. Me, I keep my cards close, eyes sharper than the twelfth rain in November. Ain't no lie so slick it don't slip up. Guess I got eyes for this kind of trick.
